text: room: does my "reclaim could start a new range" name a trend? No. That line was my opposing case, not my read. BEARISH_CHOCH means the up-structure failed (R1). With ma_50 80.24 under ma_200 87.31 the higher timeframe is markdown (C16). A new range needs a shakeout: a spring under base_low_20d that closes back above it, then a test. None is visible. Until one forms, a heavy-volume reclaim is an automatic rally inside markdown, not accumulation. livermore's line stands. Only a wide high close on volume back above the broken anchor would change me.
